open_errors.issue: In ch 17 Devan promises Neela 'I am not going back to the fort without you.' In ch 18 he rides back to Kettamala alone and leaves her at the Resin House. The bible fixes that Devan never lies to Neela, so this reads as a broken promise.
open_errors.fix: Limit the promise to today, so his ride back in ch 18 is not a lie.

patches.find: I am not going back to the fort without you. I'm not going to the horses.
patches.replace: I am not going back to the fort today. I'm not going to the horses.

open_errors.issue: Neela sleeps in the warden's chamber, not the hall. The hall is the downstairs room where the post strongbox is opened later in the same chapter.

patches.find: A bruise broke no skin, so the woman he had left sleeping in the hall above would feel none of it.
patches.replace: A bruise broke no skin, so the woman he had left sleeping in the chamber above would feel none of it.

open_errors.issue: Neela filled the flask in ch 7 and smeared resin from it for the scouting night in ch 8. In ch 11 it is still described as full.

patches.find: It was full. Black and cold and very small, with a cork she had cut herself.
patches.replace: It was nearly full, less one night's smear. Black and cold and very small, with a cork she had cut herself.

open_errors.issue: Under the wound-share, Neela's cuts appear on Devan as shallow welts that do not open (ch 7, ch 20, ch 27). In the shaft his welts 'tore wider' and 'tore a little', which means they opened.
open_errors.fix: Make the welts burn rather than tear.

patches.find: The fourth welt tore wider as he leaned, and he hissed through his nose and leaned harder.
patches.replace: The fourth welt burned hotter as he leaned, and he hissed through his nose and leaned harder.

patches.find: The welts on his back stretched and tore a little at every reach, and the sacking on his boots slid on the wet stone.
patches.replace: The welts on his back stretched and burned at every reach, and the sacking on his boots slid on the wet stone.

open_errors.issue: Devan is 32 and grew up at Kettamala, yet ch 17 says he has walked past the newel for 'twenty-two years'. That figure is Asha's age, not his.

patches.find: He had walked past it for twenty-two years, and for six of them he had not been able to put a hand on it.
patches.replace: He had walked past it all his life, and for the last six years he had not been able to put a hand on it.

open_errors.issue: Devan, who speaks in exact facts, calls Neela 'a child on a stair'. She was 21 that night: she says so in this chapter, and ch 23 states plainly that she had not been a child.

patches.find: You were a child on a stair, and a man had your eyes covered.
patches.replace: You were twenty-one, on a stair, and a man had your eyes covered.

open_errors.issue: Devan states the treaty's price, 'no fleet landing', as known fact. The tally book shows only raids allowed 'by leave'. Nothing on the page tells him what the queen got in return.

patches.find: The queen's: limited, counted, through the passes she chose, in exchange for no fleet landing.
patches.replace: The queen's: limited, counted, through the passes she chose, bought with something he could only guess at.

patches.find: Now he could see the whole bargain, and he felt like a man who has walked a long time along a wall and finds it has no door.
patches.replace: Now he could see the outline of the bargain, and he felt like a man who has walked a long time along a wall and finds it has no door.

open_errors.issue: They left the Resin House at grey dawn and rode a day and a half (ch 21–22), so they reached Kettamala in the afternoon. Ch 24 says Bhaskaran rode back 'that morning'.

patches.find: He had ridden back from the Resin House at Devan's stirrup that morning and had not said ten words since.
patches.replace: He had ridden back from the Resin House at Devan's stirrup that day and had not said ten words since.

open_errors.issue: Vasu was one of the six men left at the House, and he has ridden to Kettamala. He still says 'Six of us and Pavi' are in the sheds. Ch 25 correctly shows five men there.

patches.find: Bhaskaran's lads are outside the wall, in the sheds. Six of us and Pavi.
patches.replace: Bhaskaran's lads are outside the wall, in the sheds. The other five and Pavi.

open_errors.issue: Rema has no clerk: she writes her own receipts because Ittan's clerk is held (ch 11), and the clerk's chair is empty in ch 29. Ch 25 has her ask 'a clerk' to read Eravi's account.

patches.find: and had just asked a clerk to read Eravi's dated account into the roll for the second time.
patches.replace: and had just begun to read Eravi's dated account into the roll for the second time.

open_errors.issue: Neela carries Ammu's cord pouch in ch 1 and ch 6, and keeps it empty after ch 7. In ch 27 a cord pouch also lies beside Ammu's cloth at the blackbark tree, so the pouch is in two places.
open_errors.fix: Remove the pouch from the tree.

patches.find: A rag of blue cotton, rained on and dried and rained on again, with a cord pouch beside it, held down by a flat stone.
patches.replace: A rag of blue cotton, rained on and dried and rained on again, held down by a flat stone.

open_errors.issue: Clothes do not survive a turning: Neela always comes back naked and needs a cloth. Yet Vellan turns back at dawn 'bare to the waist', as if he were still wearing something below.
open_errors.fix: Make him naked when he turns back.

patches.find: a big bearded man lay shuddering among the roots, bare to the waist, the old resin scars pale at his throat and wrists.
patches.replace: a big bearded man lay shuddering among the roots, naked, the old resin scars pale at his throat and wrists.

open_errors.issue: Neela rules out the goat path as 'no way for a pony'. In ch 32 the forty take forty horses up it, and the watcher later finds their dung on it.
open_errors.fix: Make the path hard for ponies, not impossible.

patches.find: The goat path, ropes and scree, no way for a pony, let alone forty frightened people carrying their season's flasks.
patches.replace: The goat path, ropes and scree, hard on a pony and harder on forty frightened people carrying their season's flasks.

open_errors.issue: The kennels hold forty-one caged odiyans (ch 7, ch 14, ch 28). Neela, who is exact about counts, says 'forty more in the kennels'.

patches.find: It holds forty lives, and forty more in the kennels who can't be helped by anything now.
patches.replace: It holds forty lives, and forty-one more in the kennels who can't be helped by anything now.

open_errors.issue: Neela says she 'told Devan in the rain that no guild sells to the crown'. No such conversation appears on the page. Her reasoning that the crown hangs odiyans and does not hire them was private, in ch 3.
open_errors.fix: Make it her own private reasoning.

patches.find: I told Devan in the rain that no guild sells to the crown.
patches.replace: I told myself in the hall that the crown hangs odiyans, it doesn't hire them.
